name: Subspace — Paginate All Job Listings for a Domain

nodes.name: Set Inputs
nodes.notes:
Edit `domain` to target any company.

`page_size`: how many jobs per request (max 500). 100 is a safe default.

nodes.name: Paginate Jobs
nodes.notes:
Walks every page using jobs_next_offset until jobs_has_more is false. Emits one item per job (title, location, url, company_domain).

Auth: set SUBSPACE_API_KEY in your n8n environment (Settings → Environment variables) before running. Or replace `$env.SUBSPACE_API_KEY` in the code with your literal key.

MAX_PAGES safety cap: 50 pages × 500 = 25,000 jobs. Bump if a target domain has more.
